[[Akom]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Cathedral of Flames}}

==Dialogue==
:''"How do they do it? How do those stone claws transform themselves like that? I must find out. Can you imagine shape-shifting [[GOLEM|golem]]s? It would revolutionize our world. I would call them Transformlems. Think about it. You could have a bench or a table one moment and a humongous battle machine the next. Who wouldn't want one? I need more of their claws for my experiments. Go out and find me 5 [[Stone Claw]]s in return for:"''

==Collector items==
{{:Akom/Collector}}

==Notes==
*The trophy Akom collects is not found in the [[dungeon]] he is in.

==Trivia==
*The mention of "Transformlems" in his dialogue is an obvious reference to the [[W:The Transformers (TV series)|Transformers]]. AKOM is the animation company started by ''Transformers'''s animation director, [[W:Nelson Shin|Nelson Shin]] and produced many of its 3rd season episodes.
